name: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd
title: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd - 542649 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone EBITDA margin fell to 5.83% (from 10.36% in Q3) on onerous contracts and JV reconciliation; management guides FY27 revenue up 15-20% with margin recovery, but Q1 expected to be challenging.

triggers.label: Standalone EBITDA margin 10.36% → 5.83%
triggers.quote: EBITDA margin reduced from 10.36% in quarter three to 5.83% in quarter four FY26

triggers.label: ₹3,400 cr receivable from MoR delayed
triggers.quote: INR 3,400 crores were recoverable from MoR, which we could not get within this year, but we have received now in April

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 15-20% guided
triggers.quote: We are definitely expecting a good rise in our revenue, which will be around, say, 15-20%

triggers.label: Onerous contract charge ₹54 cr
triggers.quote: adjust for the onerous contract of INR 54 crores

guidance.quote: We are definitely expecting a good rise in our revenue, which will be around, say, 15-20%

guidance.value: improve vs FY26, Q1 FY27 slightly challenging
guidance.quote: even the margins will definitely increase. That I want to assure you. And it will be much better than this year.

guidance.value: 5 sets in first year after prototype, 120 sets in five years
guidance.quote: Thereafter, in the first year, five sets will be supplied. Thereafter, it will be increased, and the total 120 sets will be supplied in five years time.

red_flags.label: Receivables stuck: Krishnapatnam ₹1,116 cr incl. ₹890 cr interest
red_flags.quote: the total receivable, which is due from the Krishnapatnam stands at INR 1,116 crore

red_flags.label: Margin collapse on onerous contracts
red_flags.quote: The decline in the above parameter is mainly driven by a few onerous contracts and reconciliation adjustment relating to joint ventures.

red_flags.label: PAT down 43% QoQ-style margin pressure
red_flags.quote: PAT declined by 19.66% QoQ and 43.14% quarter four to quarter four compared to FY25-26

evasions.quote: we hope that in the coming two years time, mostly their receivables will be wiped out
we will not be able to explain here. There will be many strategic projects in pipeline.
